lead: Vasundhara Raje is an Indian politician, born on 8 March 1953 in Mumbai.
As of 2026, she is 73 years old, and her birth date places her under the Pisces sign.
She has held the office of Member of the Rajasthan Legislative Assembly and Member of the 11th Lok Sabha.
The sections that follow break down Vasundhara Raje's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Vasundhara Raje — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Vasundhara Raje was born on 8 March 1953 in Mumbai, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name her father, Jivajirao Scindia I of Gwalior and her mother, Vijayaraje Scindia. She is a sibling of Madhavrao Scindia and Yashodhara Raje Scindia.
She studied at Sophia College for Women.

sections.heading: Vasundhara Raje — Career and Professional Work
paras: Her professional record lists politician as her main occupation.

She has held the following offices: Member of the Rajasthan Legislative Assembly, Member of the 11th Lok Sabha, Member of the 12th Lok Sabha, Member of the 13th Lok Sabha, Member of the 9th Lok Sabha (1989–1991) and Chief Minister of Rajasthan (2003–2008). She is affiliated with Bharatiya Janata Party.

sections.heading: Vasundhara Raje — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
paras: She is married to Rana Hemant Singh.
She is a parent to Dushyant Singh.
